personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK with 6 Glass / Luxe DARK surfaces
personality_one_liner: A high-performance, cinematic command center that motivates through tactical precision and electric energy.

spacing.rule: Dense but legible for data, generous for hero elements. Thumb-zone compliance for primary actions.

do's: Bottom tab bar (translucent dark navy over scrolling data)
Sticky headers on My Plan and Workouts list
dont's: Active live workout tracker numbers (keep opaque for legibility)
Form inputs in the onboarding flow

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Personalize the user's fitness journey through interactive goal selection and a body muscle map.

states.loading: Rotating motivational text over dark background with electric green accent spinner.

screens.layout: Sticky progress bar at top. Interactive multi-step form chunked by goals. Includes a full-screen interactive muscle map (front/back views) where selected muscle groups highlight in brandPrimary. Primary CTA is sticky at the bottom, protected by safe-area padding.

screens.name: Paywall
screens.purpose: Convert users via a premium, cinematic subscription presentation.

states.error: Failed to load pricing. Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed darkened background photo with vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). 3 subscription tier cards in surfaceSecondary. 'Most Popular' tier gets a brandPrimary borderStrong and glow. Sticky bottom Continue button. Exit-intent modal triggered on top-left close tap.

screens.name: My Plan
screens.purpose: Show the daily workout schedule and allow exercise reordering.

states.empty: Illustration of a gym bag. Text: 'Rest day or ready to crush it?' CTA: 'Find a Workout'.
states.error: Unable to load today's plan. Retry button.

screens.layout: Horizontal scrollable day tabs (S/M/T/W/T/F/S). List of exercise cards using surfaceSecondary. Each card shows muscle group icon, sets, reps, and weight. Include a drag-handle on the right side. Floating Add Exercise button (glassmorphic brandTertiary over surface).

screens.name: Active Workout
screens.purpose: Real-time, live tracker command center during the workout.
screens.layout: Massive Bebas Neue live timer positioned centrally at the top. Stat cards below (Calories, Volume). Vertical list of sets with large hit-target checkboxes for completion. Rest timer overlay bottom sheet triggered after checking a set. Micro-celebration PR badges pop up upon new personal records.

screens.name: Progress
screens.purpose: Visualize user's fitness journey and consistency.

states.empty: Illustration of a blank chart. 'Complete a workout to see your stats grow.'
states.error: Could not fetch data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Dashboard grid layout. Includes a muscle distribution radar chart, weekly streak calendar (surfaceTertiary active state), and a row of PR badges. Integration statuses (Apple Health/Strava) shown as toggleable cards.

hero_gym.alt: Premium dark gym atmosphere with person lifting

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility guidelines. Utilize the deep navy/graphite backgrounds with intense Neon Green (#CCFF00) accents for all progress rings, active states, and primary CTAs.
Bebas Neue MUST be used exclusively for numbers, timers, large headers, and live metrics. Use Manrope for standard body copy, labels, and secondary reading elements.

Include a vertical gradient scrim overlay (transparent to #090C12) over any photo backgrounds (like Paywall or Workout summaries) to guarantee text legibility. Ensure the text sits in the darkest bottom 30-40%.
The Active Workout timer should dominate the screen visually. Ensure sets are presented with massive, easy-to-hit touch targets (44x44pt minimum) with haptic feedback on completion.
Wire haptics specifically for checking off a set and starting/stopping the timer as defined in the 'events' map.

Research finding: Based on Mobbin analysis, premium fitness apps in 2026 minimize UI noise during active states. Limit form-factor distractions. Stick to absolute necessity on the Active Workout tracking screen.
